name: Contribution ceilings, 25% tax bracket
about: ₱150,000 a month. SSS stops at the top ₱35,000 MSC, PhilHealth at the ₱100,000 ceiling, Pag-IBIG at ₱10,000.
workings: SSS -875.00: MSC 35,000.00 × 5% = 1,750.00 a month; the rest after the first cutoff's half
PHILHEALTH -1,250.00: premium 5% × 100,000.00 = 5,000.00; employee half 2,500.00; the rest after the first cutoff's half
PAGIBIG -100.00: 2% × 10,000.00 = 200.00 a month; the rest after the first cutoff's half
